description: Runs the CL3 owner contract suites and fails closed until staging and production showcase receipts exist.

notApplicableKinds.reason: CL3 production-health contracts apply to scenario-to-cloud scenario deployments, not to the control-plane process itself.

concurrency.reason: The phase launches bounded Go owner-test commands and must not overlap another CL3 or LPBS phase run.

determinism.reason: The phase executes the current owner test suites and requires remote staging/production receipts that change independently of source files.

levels.name: Unverified
levels.description: Local contracts have not been run.
exit_criteria: The owner contract suite has run and is retained in the Test Genie phase result.

levels.name: Local contracts verified
levels.description: The local health, TLS, DBM, CLI, and LPBS delivery-health contracts passed.
entry_criteria: The exact owner tests ran against current source.
exit_criteria: CL2 staging rehearsal and restore receipts are verified.

levels.name: Staging showcase verified
levels.description: Staging runs the current build with delivered mail/alerts and a verified off-host restore.
exit_criteria: A1-approved production redeploy and current production observation are retained.

levels.name: Production health verified
levels.description: Production is healthy on the current release with TLS and health observation, after the reviewed redeploy.
entry_criteria: Staging showcase receipts passed and A1 approved the redeploy.
exit_criteria: Production health is healthy, TLS exceeds 60 days, build identity matches the release, and sign-in mail and alert delivery are verified.

capabilities.label: Production Health
capabilities.description: Local contracts, staging backup/restore and delivery, and current production health are independent evidence stages.

levels.name: Local contracts
levels.description: Owner tests pass with local test doubles.
exit_criteria: CL2 staging rehearsal, mail/alert delivery, off-host schedule, verification, and restore receipts pass.
levels.capability_summary: The local code contracts have evidence, but no staging or production claim is made.
levels.next_unlock: Prove the current build and restore on CL2 staging.

levels.name: Staging proven
levels.description: Staging provides current-build rehearsal and off-host restore receipts.
entry_criteria: All required staging receipts are verified.
exit_criteria: A1-approved production deploy and healthy current-build observation pass.
levels.next_unlock: Obtain A1 approval and verify production.

levels.name: Production healthy
levels.description: The current release is healthy and monitored on production.
entry_criteria: Staging evidence passed and A1-approved deploy completed.
exit_criteria: Healthy production, current build identity, TLS over 60 days, sign-in mail and delivered alerts are verified.
levels.capability_summary: Production health is observed on the current release with delivery and recovery evidence.
levels.next_unlock: Keep scheduled health, TLS, mail, and backup evidence current.

cl3.local_contracts_failed.reason: Run and repair the owner test suites.

cl3.staging_showcase_missing.reason: Prove current build, mail/alerts, off-host backup verification and restore on CL2 staging.

cl3.production_showcase_missing.reason: After staging, obtain A1 approval and retain a healthy production observation with current build identity and TLS evidence.
